subject: general
question:
**A part of the given sentence which has been underlined may contain a spelling error. Select the option that correctly rectifies the spelling error. If there is no error, select ‘No error’**

The police came to the accident spot after receiving an __annonymous__ phone call.
solution: The correct answer is option 3), i.e., "Anonymous." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling is 'Anonymous.' • 'Anonymous' means 'not identified by name; of unknown name.' (गुमनाम, अज्ञातकृत) • Example: • *The money was donated by an **anonymous** benefactor.* • The sentence describes an incident where the police came to the site of an accident after receiving an **unkonown phone call. ** • Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.​​ ​ **Correct Sentence:__** *The police came to the accident spot after receiving an __**anonymous**__ phone call.* 1cf:Tdb41,
